purpose: Temporarily store event-driven turn journals and legacy conversation records for specification and operational analysis.

constraints.begin_turn: Must persist before substantive work and capture timestamp, topics, categories, immediate topic and instructions.
constraints.scratchpad: Chronological evidence-based operational notes; excludes hidden chain-of-thought.
constraints.end_task: Requirement-level outcomes at task completion/termination, not automatically at every turn.
constraints.end_turn: Finalize reply verbatim and record it before sending.
constraints.historical_records: Preserve all prior version 1.1.0 entries without migration or modification.

lifecycle: begin_turn -> scratchpad (zero or more) -> optional end_task -> end_turn. All events operate on one persisted journal identified by turn_key; task_id relates multiple turns.
